Tofu Pudding
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 3:18am

Ingredients




1 pound soft tofu
2 smalls bananas
1 lemon, Juice of
2 cups sliced strawberries
cup maple syrup
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2 tablespoons tahini
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon almond extract
6 whls strawberries, for garnish

Preparation

1 6 SERVINGS VEGAN 2 Tofu, fresh strawberries, bananas and maple syrup give a wealth of flavor to this smooth and creamy pudding from Northern Pines spa in Maine. Try also serving it for breakfast as a light, nutritious alternative to yogurt or cereals. 3 In food processor or blender, combine all ingredients and process until smooth. Pour mixture into dessert cups. Chill for at least 1 hour. 4 Garnish each with a strawberry.
